model_annotation: The plot illustrates the coverage achieved by four different language models—Llama-3B, Llama-3B + FT, Llama-1B, and Llama-1B + FT—as a function of the number of completions (k), which is displayed on a logarithmic scale along the x-axis ranging from 2⁰ to 2⁸ (i.e., 1 to 256). The y-axis represents coverage, scaled linearly from 0.4 to 0.8. The x-axis tick labels are powers of two, spaced at intervals of 2⁰, 2¹, ..., 2⁸. The blue line with circular markers represents Llama-3B, starting at approximately 0.42 coverage at k=1 and increasing to about 0.87 at k=256. The green line with triangular markers, representing Llama-3B + FT, begins slightly above 0.42 and rises to approximately 0.88 at k=256. The light blue line with diamond markers for Llama-1B starts at 0.4 and reaches about 0.85 at k=256. The light green line with star markers for Llama-1B + FT begins at 0.4 and increases to roughly 0.83 at k=256. All four lines show a steady increase in coverage with more completions, with Llama-3B + FT achieving the highest coverage and Llama-1B + FT the lowest among the four.
